conventions.annualization: none: every ratio is per equity point, as the BTC-188 parameter-surface owner reports Sharpe
conventions.closed_trade: a BTC-180 PaperTradeAccounting whose closed is true; open trades are reported separately and enter no closed-trade metric
conventions.period_return: (nav_i - nav_{i-1}) / nav_{i-1} over consecutive BTC-180 EquityPoints, the first against the run's starting NAV (parameter_surfaces._period_returns)
conventions.runs: each metric is computed for the headline evaluation-window run per venue and cost rung, and per BTC-182 fold
conventions.status: a metric that cannot be computed carries its undefined status, never zero

cross_venue.definition: two trades on different venues match when their ARM_ENTRY ledger rows share the daily decision instant and the setup; per venue pair: matched, only-first and only-second counts and matched / (matched + only-first + only-second); and the count matched on all three venues
cross_venue.undefined: NO_TRADES on both venues of a pair

cross_venue.definition: per matched pair (second venue against first, venues in the order bitstamp, coinbase, bitfinex): the relative difference (second - first) / first of the average entry price, the initial stop price and the average exit price (exit notional over exited quantity, closed trades only); and the difference of MFE and of MAE, each over its own trade's initial risk (R units, under PaperTradeAccounting's SIGNED_GROSS_PNL_FULL_BARS_AND_FILL_ENDPOINTS_V1 excursions); per pair: the matched count, the mean, the median and the largest absolute difference of each
per venue pair: among matched pairs whose trades are both closed, the count where exactly one trade exited through the BTC-180 STRUCTURAL_STOP exit, beside the matched closed count
for each primary metric and cost rung: the three venues' values and their maximum minus minimum, when the metric is defined on all three venues; otherwise the venues' statuses

metric_spec.cross_venue_section: policy V7 section 8 cross-venue source sensitivity (clarification 4a)

metrics.undefined: NO_CLOSED_TRADES (this specification's name for the owner's None)

metrics.definition: mean r_multiple over closed trades whose r_multiple is not None; the count used is reported
metrics.undefined: NO_R_MULTIPLE (this specification's name for the owner's None)

metrics.definition: mean period return over its sample standard deviation (n-1), unannualized, zero risk-free rate
mean period return over the downside deviation sqrt(sum(min(r, 0)^2) / n) over all n period returns, unannualized, zero target and risk-free rate (the Sharpe convention's periods)
return fraction over max_drawdown, unannualized; per fold the fold's return, for the walk-forward the mean fold return
largest (peak - nav) / peak over the equity curve, the peak starting at the starting NAV; the walk-forward reports the worst fold
mean of net_pnl / entry_notional over closed trades
closed trades with net_pnl > 0 over closed trades; a flat trade is not a win
sum of positive closed net_pnl over the absolute sum of negative closed net_pnl
mean net_pnl over closed trades with net_pnl > 0
mean net_pnl over closed trades with net_pnl < 0 (negative)
equity points with open_quantity > 0 over all equity points of the run
sum over trades of entry_notional + exit_notional, over the mean equity-point NAV, unannualized; the run's length in days is reported beside it
the run's trades, with the closed count and the count open at the run's end beside it
metrics.undefined: never undefined; zero is a count

metrics.definition: the longest time underwater, in hours (seconds / 3600). The running peak starts at the run's starting NAV at the run's started_at (its first bar's timestamp) and rises to each equity point's nav above it; an equity point whose nav is at or above the running peak is at the peak. A drawdown begins at the latest at-peak instant (started_at for the starting NAV, else that point's as_of) before an equity point whose nav is strictly below the running peak, and ends at the as_of of the first later point at or above that peak (recovered) or, if none, at the run's last equity point's as_of (unrecovered). A run with no point strictly below its running peak has longest drawdown 0 hours; of equal lengths the first is reported, with its recovered or unrecovered mark. Per fold, the fold's run; the walk-forward reports the longest fold value, as max_drawdown reports the worst fold

examples.case: first point below the starting NAV

metrics.examples_note: each point is [hours after started_at of its as_of, its nav]

metrics.definition: the most consecutive closed trades, ordered by closed_at, with net_pnl < 0; a trade with net_pnl >= 0 ends a streak
metrics.undefined: never undefined; zero with no closed trade

metric_spec.trade_count_rule: every rate is reported beside the trade count it is computed over (policy V7 section 8)
